subject: history
title: Freedom Struggle Timeline (1757-1947)
description: Complete chronological timeline from Battle of Plassey to Independence

content.overview: A comprehensive timeline of the Indian freedom struggle from the Battle of Plassey (1757) to Independence (1947).
keyPoints: 1757: Battle of Plassey - British established political control in Bengal
1764: Battle of Buxar - British defeated Mughal, Awadh, and Bengal combined forces
1765: Diwani Rights - British got revenue collection rights in Bengal, Bihar, Orissa
1773: Regulating Act - Warren Hastings as first Governor-General of Bengal
1784: Pitt's India Act - Board of Control established
1806: Vellore Mutiny - first major military uprising against British
1853: First railway line (Bombay to Thane), first telegraph line
1857: Revolt of 1857 - First War of Independence, Sepoy Mutiny
1858: Government of India Act - Crown rule began, Queen Victoria's Proclamation
1877: Queen Victoria became Empress of India
1911: Delhi Durbar, Capital shifted to Delhi

quiz.explanation: Battle of Plassey was fought in 1757

quiz.explanation: The Revolt of 1857 is also known as Sepoy Mutiny or First War of Independence
